# doit_billing_gcp_account (Resource)

Connects a Google Cloud billing account to DoiT, so DoiT imports its billing data from the detailed usage cost export in BigQuery.

Before connecting, grant the DoiT service account from `doit_billing_gcp_requirements` the roles it lists, and enable the detailed usage cost export (Google offers no API for that step). While granted access propagates, the API refuses the connection; the provider retries until the create timeout ends.

Creating the resource records the connection as `pending` and returns; DoiT activates it in the background, which takes up to about 40 minutes. The provider does not wait for that. Read `status` and `failure_reason` to follow it.

~> **Note:** Create adopts an existing `pending` or `active` connection of the same billing account and export, including one made in the DoiT console. A later `terraform destroy` then disconnects that billing account, even though Terraform did not create the connection. Two configurations must not manage the same billing account.

~> **Note:** The connection cannot be disconnected while it is still activating. Destroying or replacing it in that time fails; retry when `status` is `active` or `failed`. Disconnecting leaves the IAM grants and the export dataset in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "doit_billing_gcp_account" "this" {
  billing_account_id = "012345-6789AB-CDEF01"
  export_project_id  = "example-project"
  export_dataset_id  = "billing_export"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account_id` (String) Google Cloud billing account ID. Cannot be changed in place; disconnect and connect again.
- `export_dataset_id` (String) BigQuery dataset the detailed usage cost export writes to. Cannot be changed in place; disconnect and connect again.
- `export_project_id` (String) Google Cloud project holding the detailed usage cost export dataset. Cannot be changed in place; disconnect and connect again.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `failure_reason` (String) Why the connection is `failed` and what to do next. Present only when `status` is `failed`.
- `id` (String) The ID of the connection, equal to `billing_account_id`.
- `status` (String) Activation state: `pending` while DoiT activates the connection in the background, `active` once billing import is set up, `failed` (see `failure_reason`) when the activation or a disconnect did not finish. The provider does not wait for `active`; the next refresh reads the current state.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import doit_billing_gcp_account.this 012345-6789AB-CDEF01
```
